entries.note: Outlines derived from Overture Maps division_area (ODbL 1.0). The lakes object of each subject is Natural Earth 10m lakes, public domain (https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector). The places files (maps/places/) combine Natural Earth populated places, public domain, with Wikidata, CC0 (sights, https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Wikidata:Licensing), and, for countries where Natural Earth lists fewer than 8 cities, GeoNames, CC BY 4.0 (https://www.geonames.org/, attribution required). The packs (maps/packs/) are the regions of the same Overture divisions, simplified more finely.
